title: Biased total influence and sensitivity
statement: Let $p\\in(0,1)$ and let $f$ be a function from the sign cube on $n$ coordinates to $\\{\\pm1\\}$. Under the product distribution in which each coordinate has bias parameter $p$, the total influence of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ equals $4p(1-p)$ times the expected number of coordinates whose flip changes the value of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
